name: MSBench-FIS
description: This record contains the data, code, results and figures accompanying the manuscript "An Adaptive Dynamic Anchor-Controlled Boolean-to-Neuro-Spherical Fuzzy Framework for Fault Detection and Lyapunov-Stable Control in Multi-Sensor Aerial Systems" (R. Amirova). Dataset. MSBench-FIS is a synthetic-fault multi-sensor aerial benchmark of 200,000 records. Each record holds a timestamp, three-axis gyroscope and accelerometer readings, three-axis position and velocity, and the accelerometer and gyroscope magnitudes. There are five classes of 40,000 records each: Normal and four injected fault types (Gaussian noise, bias, drift, IMU dropout), the faults at three severity levels (13 scenarios). The Train/Validation/Test split (140,002 / 29,999 / 29,999 records) is grouped by timestamp, so no timestamp occurs in more than one partition. Acoustic modality. Version 2 adds eight acoustic descriptors measured on 129 one-second windows of the public Eclipse Soundscapes ESID#721 AudioMoth recordings. Each record receives the window that corresponds to its timestamp. The audio is ambient field recording, not drone audio; it carries no injected fault and is independent of the fault class. It serves as a negative-control modality. Code and results.
